verdict.rationale: Devin accepts plain-language descriptions of bugs and feature requests and starts work sessions from them, via Slack/Teams threads, Linear/Jira tickets, or the web app. However, the evidence shows it going straight to implementation. Nothing documents an explicit step that turns that intent into a scoped spec or task breakdown, apart from a general suggestion to carve out independent tasks for parallel Devins. Missing for 10: documented conversion of plain-language intent into a scoped implementation task or plan, user review/approval of that scope before coding, and independent hands-on corroboration of scoping quality.
